text:
Maya P.: Quick UX question — leaning towards rounded (8px) buttons for primary actions in the console. Thoughts on keeping chips as pills or making both match?

Alex W.: Prefer 8px for buttons. Pills feel too prominent in dense tables. Also worried the current focus ring sits outside the hit area and looks jumpy.

Liam G.: Agree on 8px. One nit: the focus outline being outside the button makes keyboard users lose the visual anchor when tabbing. Proposal: move focus inside with a 2px inset ring.

Samira R.: @Liam G. can you drop a quick sketch? Also, toast stacking question — if we inset the ring, do toasts need extra margin so they don't visually collide with top-aligned controls?

Maya P.: Sketch in this thread (emoji: not attached here) but high level: buttons: 8px radius, chips: 12px radius. Toast spacing: 12px from top edge, 8px between stacked toasts.

Alex W.: Quick CSS example for context:
```css
.button { border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; }
.toast-container { gap: 8px; margin-top: 12px; }
```
Inset ring looks fine visually but we lose a bit of perceived padding. I suggest +4px horizontal padding to compensate. Also what's the token name for this radius currently?

Liam G.: Current token is `token-radius-md`. I'd prefer semantic tokens like `radius/button-md` and `radius/chip-sm` so devs know intent. Also add migration notes for existing usages.

Samira R.: Accessibility check: with inset 2px ring, contrast for ghost (outline) buttons drops for low-vision users. We should run a quick a11y audit and add `aria-label`s for icon-only buttons in tables — I've seen missing labels in the routing table.

Maya P.: Agreed. Action items: 1) draft token rename proposal, 2) PR for padding bump + visual tests, 3) a11y audit on ghost/icon buttons. Who can take 1 & 2?

Alex W.: I'll take 2 — I'll open a PR and include visual diffs and a code example.

Liam G.: I'll draft the token rename RFC, include a mapping table (`token-radius-md` -> `radius/button-md`) and migration script notes.

Samira R.: I'll run the a11y audit (quick sweep) and add a checklist to Alex's PR. Will flag any contrast fails or missing `aria-*`.

DevBot: deploy-preview created: https://redwood-internal/pr/4823 — visual diffs include button radius and toast spacing.

Maya P.: Thanks all — let's reconvene after PR review. :thumbsup:

DevBot: Reactions summary: :thumbsup: x3, :eyes: x2
